title: Miss Vera Tear

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Station,

Date 19.
Subject
Made by Forwarded by
Miss Vera Emil, Russian, born on January 26, 1905 at
Harbin, is at present residing at 235/4 Avenue Haig.
She left Shanghai for Surabaya on September 14, 1939
by S.S. "Tjibadak" and returned to Shanghai on June 8,
1940 by S.S. "Tjibadak". While at Surabaya she was
employed as a bar-maid at the Tabarin Night Club.
Miss Emil will, in the near future, marry a Mr.
J. Wanschenck, Netherlander merchant, who is coming here
from Surabaya.
Miss Emil is reported to be of a good character
and repute.
Enquiries revealed no information which may
suggest that Miss Emil was engaged in any activities
on behalf of either German or Japanese espionage
organization.

薇拉·埃米尔（Vera Emil）小姐，俄国人，1905年1月26日出生于哈尔滨，现居住在海格路235/4号。
她于1939年9月14日乘“芝巴达”号（S.S. "Tjibadak"）轮船离开上海前往泗水，并于1940年6月8日乘同一艘轮船返回上海。在泗水期间，她在塔巴林夜总会（Tabarin Night Club）担任酒吧女侍。
埃米尔小姐将于近期与一位来自泗水的荷兰商人 J. Wanschenck 先生结婚。
据报埃米尔小姐品行端正，声誉良好。
经查询，未发现任何信息表明埃米尔小姐曾参与代表德国或日本间谍组织的任何活动。

June 15th, 1940.

SECRET

Miss VERA TEAR, probably a cabaret "hostess" was
employed at the TABARIN NIGHT CLUB in Surabaya in
April and is now reported to have left Hanoi for
Shanghai. She is believed to be connected with the
Japanese or German espionage organiza' ion.
If she could be located in Shanghai I would be
grateful if I might be informed.

"Y"
page_data.zh:
1940年6月15日。

机密

薇拉·蒂尔（VERA TEAR）小姐，可能是一名歌舞厅“女招待”，四月份受雇于泗水的塔巴林夜总会（TABARIN NIGHT CLUB），据报现已离开河内前往上海。据信她与日本或德国间谍组织有关联。
如果能在上海找到她，若能告知我，我将不胜感激。

“Y”

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch 814601/
REPORT
Date July 4, 19 39

Subject. Communication dated 17-6-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Misses Vera Tear, Helen Afanassieff and Nina Drosdoff.

Made by... D.S.I. Prokofiev ...Forwarded by... C. Cousin. S. J.

1. Miss Vera Victorovna TEAR, Russian, born
on February 26, 1909 at Harbin. According to her own state-
ment, she escaped from the U.S.S.R. to Manchuria in 1924 to-
gether with her parents and until 1929 resided in Harbin
where she claims to have graduated from a commercial school.
She arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in 1929. Here she is
reported to have been employed as a shop assistant for
about two years, after which she has been working as a dan-
cing partner. She resides at 129 Avenue Haig, House 16.

2. Miss Helen Alexandrovna AFANASSIEFF, Russian,
born on October 12, 1908 at Harbin. She is reported to have
arrived in Harbin from Vladivostok in 1927 and after a
short stay in the former city to have proceeded to Shanghai.
Here she is known to have been working as a dancing part-
ner in local cabarets and to have visited Hankow in the
same capacity. At present she resides at 129 Avenue Haig,
House 16.

3. Miss Nina Petrovna DROSDOFF, Russian, born on
January 7, 1909 at Harbin. It is reported that she arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin in or about 1930 travelling on a
Soviet passport. While in Shanghai she renounced her alle-
giance to the Soviet Government and took out emigrant pa-
pers. For the past several years she is known to have been
working as a dancing partner. Her present address is
No. 1326 Avenue Joffre, Apt. 203.

The above three persons are registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the
French Police ( Certificates of Resid. Nos. 6067, 2059 and

制作者... D.S.I. 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev） ...转呈者... C. Cousin. S. J.

1. 薇拉·维克托罗芙娜·蒂尔（Vera Victorovna TEAR）小姐，俄国人，1909年2月26日出生于哈尔滨。据其自述，她于1924年与父母一起从苏联逃往满洲，并在哈尔滨居住至1929年，她声称在此期间从一所商业学校毕业。她于1929年从哈尔滨抵达上海。据报她在此担任店员约两年，此后一直从事舞伴工作。她居住在海格路129号16室。

2. 海伦·亚历山德罗芙娜·阿法纳西耶夫（Helen Alexandrovna AFANASSIEFF）小姐，俄国人，1908年10月12日出生于哈尔滨。据报她于1927年从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达哈尔滨，在该市短暂停留后前往上海。据悉她曾在当地的歌舞厅担任舞伴，并曾以同样身份访问汉口。目前她居住在海格路129号16室。

3. 尼娜·彼得罗芙娜·德罗兹多夫（Nina Petrovna DROSDOFF）小姐，俄国人，1909年1月7日出生于哈尔滨。据报她大约在1930年持苏联护照从哈尔滨抵达上海。在上海期间，她放弃了对苏联政府的效忠，并办理了移民证件。众所周知，过去几年她一直从事舞伴工作。她目前的地址是霞飞路1326号203室。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1878.                                SHANGHAI,    17th June 1939 .

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that the following persons have
applied to this Consulate General for a visé for admission into the
Netherlands Indies :

1. Miss VERA TEAR, born at Harbin on February 26th 1909, residing at
   Shanghai at 129 Avenue Haig, House 16.
2. Miss HELEN AFANASSIEVA, born at Harbin on October 12th 1908, re-
   siding at Shanghai at 129 Avenue Haig, House 16.
3. Miss NINA DROSDOVA, born at Harbin on January 27th 1909, residing
   at 1326 Avenue Joffre, Apartment No.203.

They stated to me that they have been engaged by the Tabarin Night
Club at Sourabaia as bargirls for a period of six months and that
their contracts, together with their landing permits have been
forwarded to this Consulate General.
            more
    Further they informed me that they have been residing at Shanghai
for the last ten years and that they have been registered with the
Police of the French Municipal Council.

    At present they seem to be employed with the Casanova Cabaret
as dancing girls. They have the intention to leave next month after
receipt of their documents from Sourabaia.

    I should be obliged to you if you would let me know whether any-
thing is known against these persons from a political or moral point
of view.

                                        I have the honour to be,
                                                Sir,
                                        Your obedient servant,

                                        (Signature)

                                        Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner of Police,
        Special Branch,
                SHANGHAI.

                D. C. J. Prokofieff
                (Signature)

第1878号。                                上海，1939年6月17日。

先生，

    谨此通知您，下列人员已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证：

1. 薇拉·蒂尔（VERA TEAR）小姐，1909年2月26日出生于哈尔滨，居住在上海海格路129号16室。
2. 海伦·阿法纳西耶娃（HELEN AFANASSIEVA）小姐，1908年10月12日出生于哈尔滨，居住在上海海格路129号16室。
3. 尼娜·德罗兹多娃（NINA DROSDOVA）小姐，1909年1月27日出生于哈尔滨，居住在霞飞路1326号203室。

她们向我陈述，已被泗水（Sourabaia）的塔巴林夜总会（Tabarin Night Club）聘为酒吧女侍，为期六个月，且她们的合同及登陆许可证已寄送至本总领事馆。
            续下页
    此外，她们告知我，过去十年一直居住在上海，并已在法公董局警察处登记。

    目前，她们似乎受雇于卡萨诺瓦歌舞厅（Casanova Cabaret）担任舞女。她们打算在下个月收到来自泗水的文件后离境。

    若蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握有关这些人员的任何不良记录，我将不胜感激。

                                        谨致，
                                                先生，
                                        您顺从的仆人，

                                        （签名）

                                        总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
        特别分部
                副总监

                D. C. J. Prokofieff
                （签名）
